primary_header.DESCRIP: CDS readnoise file from commissioning plus cycle 1 and 2 data
primary_header.AUTHOR: NIRCam Instrument Team

actual_HISTORY: Description of Reference File Creation
This file contains the CDS noise in BUNITS of ADU.
The CDS noise was derived from NINTS dark integrations
obtained in RAPID mode during commissioning and/or
normal ops calibration programs. Each inetgration
was processed with the equivalent of full level1 pipeline
processing through U of A ncdhas software. All data were
reference corrected (where available), bias and IPC corrected,
saturation, linearity, and jump detection performed (sat and
and lin being essentially NO-OPS on dark data). For each
processed ramp/integration, independent CDS samples were computed.
e.g. for an NGROUP rapid ramp, NGROUP/2 total CDS samples are
calculated - G1-G0, G3-G2,...,G(N-4)-G(N-3),G(N-2)-G(N-1)
This procdedure minimizes the possible introduction of correlated
noise in the CDS noise metric and results in NSAMPLES independent
samples of the CDS signal. The CDS noise recorded in this file is
computed as the sigma clipped average of the stack of these NSAMPLES
for each pixel. The CRDS definition of the noise file specifies
only a single extension containing the the CDS noise for the
reference file structure, and that structure is honored here. A crude
estimate of the uncertainty in the CDS noise is computed treating
the NINTS ramps to separately compute a CDS noise as above. The
uncertainty in the CDS noise is taken as the standard deviation of
the resistant mean of the NINTS separate estimates of the CDS noise
and is available as a separate FITS file not delivered with the
CDS noise reference file.
This readnoise array was constructed using all available dark fi
les from programs 1453 and 4442 between the dates given in PEDIG
REE.
derived_relation: The source supplies per-pixel marginal CDS standard deviations after an earlier reference/bias/IPC processing operator P. It constrains diag(D_CDS P C_raw P^T D_CDS^T), not the full C_raw or its new-SIRS projection.
non_identification: Many raw temporal/interpixel covariance matrices produce the same processed CDS diagonal. Actual ncdhas P and covariance/cross-reference measurements are needed to infer raw noise. Reference ERR or CDS arrays alone do not define that inverse relation.
consequence: Assigning CDS^2/2 as independent raw ADC variances and then adding new SIRS reference covariance is an explicit conditional approximation with possible double accounting, not a source-complete instrument covariance.
